description: Journal producer-facing layout lifecycle. Read paths remain broader than producer write paths for legacy compatibility.

lifecycle.notes: Local observers may assemble incomplete segment contents under a draft key before upload or finalization.

producer_write_paths: POST /app/devices/ingest multipart fields day, segment, source/meta, files[]
lifecycle.notes: Native observers submit a normalized segment envelope plus files; the journal validates before writing.
Accepted producer paths are stream-qualified. Readers tolerate older flat and prefixed names.
Finalized segment keys carry start time and duration, with no per-record schema_version.
